mapper.select: SELECT * FROM material_category WHERE status = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC
SELECT * FROM material_category ORDER BY sort_order ASC, id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT c.* FROM material_category c JOIN material_item i ON c.id = i.category_id AND i.deleted = 0 WHERE i.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT l.item_id FROM material_request_line l JOIN material_request r ON l.request_id = r.id WHERE r.deleted = 0 AND r.applicant_group = #{applicantGroup} UNION SELECT DISTINCT m.item_id FROM material_stock_movement m LEFT JOIN material_request r2 ON m.request_id = r2.id LEFT JOIN aro_personnel p ON m.applicant_user_id = p.user_id WHERE r2.applicant_group = #{applicantGroup} OR p.project_group_name = #{applicantGroup} ) ORDER BY c.sort_order ASC, c.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO material_category (name, sort_order, status) VALUES (#{name}, #{sortOrder}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE material_category SET name = #{name}, sort_order = #{sortOrder}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
